stories.title: Never-before-seen footage unearthed! How Ted Williams' hitting philosophy holds up in 2026
stories.summary: After unearthing a debate between the greatest hitter ever and a Hall of Fame teammate, we had a modern star explain how the takes hold up in today's MLB.

stories.title: Passan: Why Tommy John's legacy will forever live on across baseball
stories.summary: John won 288 games over more than two decades.

stories.title: Sources: Seahawks still plan on signing CB Arnold
stories.summary: The Seattle Seahawks are still planning to sign cornerback Terrion Arnold, but it will take a while, as they are working through the timing, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Chiefs' Bieniemy: Wife on 'great road to recovery'
stories.summary: Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy said Tuesday that his wife, Mia, is on track to make a full recovery after she was allegedly shot by the couple's son last month in the family's home in Virginia.

stories.title: 'I'm here to win': Miller has big plans as Cowboy
stories.summary: Thrilled to be with the Dallas Cowboys on a one-year contract, Von Miller, 37, spoke to reporters on Tuesday at training camp in Oxnard, California, and the club will work the veteran linebacker into practice slowly, giving him time to acclimate.
